research_integrity: Classical Fréchet derivative credited to prior literature; the reported contribution is the exact two-ended entrywise norm optimization and its sharp extremal orientation. Proof is self-contained except standard matrix square-root functional calculus. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: No higher-dimensional, nonsymmetric, complex, componentwise-relative, or induced-row-sum-norm claim. The supremum may require a limiting sequence; supplementary numerical tests are not infinite proofs. Earlier equivalent work under different terms remains a historical-priority risk.
scientific_scope: Real symmetric two-by-two positive-definite matrices with spectrum in a fixed interval \([a,b]\), \(0<a<b\); global sharp absolute-entry maximum-norm Lipschitz coefficient of the principal square-root map, with a sharp unbounded-upper-spectral-endpoint limit.
title: Sharp entrywise stability of the two-by-two positive-definite matrix square root
